entities.summary: Xenophon of Ephesus was a Greek writer. His surviving work is the Ephesian Tale of Anthia and Habrocomes, otherwise known as the Ephesiaka. It is one of the earliest novels as well as one of the sources for Shakespeare's Romeo and Juliet.
